# llm-d's deploy/config/pd-epp-config.yaml with the always-disagg-pd-decider in place of the
# prefix-based one: every request is disaggregated (prefill on a prefill-role pod, decode on a
# decode-role pod). The P/D scenarios here name it in their router block.
apiVersion: llm-d.ai/v1
kind: EndpointPickerConfig
plugins:
- type: approx-prefix-cache-producer
  parameters:
    maxPrefixTokensToMatch: 16384
    lruCapacityPerServer: 31250
- type: prefix-cache-scorer
- type: queue-scorer
- type: prefill-filter
- type: decode-filter
- type: max-score-picker
- type: always-disagg-pd-decider
- type: disagg-profile-handler
  parameters:
    deciders:
      prefill: always-disagg-pd-decider
schedulingProfiles:
- name: prefill
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: prefill-filter
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 1
- name: decode
  plugins:
  - pluginRef: decode-filter
  - pluginRef: max-score-picker
  - pluginRef: prefix-cache-scorer
    weight: 2
  - pluginRef: queue-scorer
    weight: 1

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 512: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 512) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: fabric_bandwidth_efficiency
assumptions.Scope: 1: the scenario's coefficient sets carry no fabric_bandwidth_efficiency scoped to fabric ib-400g, so every byte that crosses it is priced at the catalog's nominal line rate

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no per-kind decode rate for sparse_mla attention, so it is priced with the part-wide attention pair and any per-kind floor is not used

assumptions.Name: attention_decode_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_sparse_mla
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs

assumptions.Name: attention_prefill_rate_block_index_scores
assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for the block_index_scores kernel, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on its scoring FLOPs

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.33.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 512: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 512) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured decode form for the block_index_scores kernel, so it is priced with its attention kind's pair

assumptions.Scope: absent: not in the scenario's coefficient sets: no measured prefill form for sparse_mla attention, so its prefill is priced with the part-wide prefill pair on the attention FLOPs
